samples.stimulus: To investigate a daily ear-training app, a team recorded the pitch accuracy score of each participant among a set of musicians, some of whom used it. A computer randomly assigned each participant to a group. The graph shows the results.
samples.question: Which statement about the study is most appropriate?
options: Using a daily ear-training app is associated with a lower mean pitch accuracy score, but the study does not show that it caused the difference.
Using a daily ear-training app caused a lower mean pitch accuracy score among the participants.
Using a daily ear-training app is associated with a higher mean pitch accuracy score, but the study does not show that it caused the difference.
Using a daily ear-training app caused a higher mean pitch accuracy score among the participants.
samples.answer: Using a daily ear-training app caused a higher mean pitch accuracy score among the participants.
samples.explanation: (1) 처치 결정 방법: 무작위 배정. (2) 무작위 배정이면 두 조건의 다른 차이가 고르게 섞여 인과 결론이 가능하다. (3) 막대에서 평균을 읽는다: 사용 80, 비사용 40. (4) 사용자 평균이 더 높다. (5) 따라서 인과 결론 + 해당 방향. 따라서 정답은 D이다.
